name: Jean
source: Valery's mother, a Californian who trains at and runs her own gym. Jean does not simply keep in shape: she has a bodybuilder's physique and trains as if the world owed her an explanation. Calm and authoritative without ever raising her voice, she is a natural leader and a surrogate mother figure to Daisy. She raised Valery alone. [spoiler]Her husband, Nathan Cole, disappeared without a trace years ago. She suspects The Labs was involved but has never been able to prove it, and told Valery that he had died.[/spoiler]
